ModMetaData.name: Avali Continued (1.7)
ModMetaData.author: arekku255 (1.7 update); Erisss, FacePlus, Ksisa, XY78
ModMetaData.description:
Adds the Avali race to RimWorld: small, fluffy, nomadic pack hunters with a bad temper and a love of the cold. If you're interested in the lore, check out the Avali wiki: https://avali.fandom.com/wiki/The_Official_Avali_Wiki
This is an update of Avali Continued for RimWorld 1.7.
Features - Avali race with their own biology: packs that bond and buff each other, egg laying and kits, cold-adapted temperature range, and Avali-specific thoughts. - Avali factions, traders, pawn kinds and a "Lost Pack" start scenario. - Avali buildings, furniture, weapons, apparel, implants, food and research.
1.7 update - Rebuilt for RimWorld 1.7 and current Humanoid Alien Races. - Ideology support (factions have cultures; fixes starting with no colonists). - Multiplayer: turret and weapon buttons are synced; no desyncing randomness in drawing code. - Fixes for several old bugs (unpowered holo TV / karaoke errors, silent precursor guns, female tail graphic).
Requires Harmony and Humanoid Alien Races. Not compatible with the older Avali Continued [1.2] being active at the same time.
Known issues carried over from the original: some backstories have placeholder text.
Credits - C# and XML code by Erisss - Graphics by FacePlus - Formerly maintained by Ksisa and Chennex/XY78 - Avali race by RyuujinZERO - RimWorld 1.7 update by arekku255
